annotations.title: Check all citations in a text

description: Check every legal citation in a text in one call. Call it on a draft (contract, memo, AI answer) before it is used: it finds citations that are not in the corpus and citations to norms that are no longer in force, and gives the date the corpus last checked each source. text = the document; default_jur = the jurisdiction to assume when a citation does not name one (e.g. ru). Returns a tally and one finding per citation: in force, repealed, not found, or not verified. 'Not found' means the citation is not in the corpus; confirm such cases with lexatlas_search before calling them wrong. Send long documents in parts.
name: lexatlas_citecheck
title: Check all citations in a text
